answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require proof-of-useful-work bonds: each identity locks a small stake and builds a verifiable history of peer-graded tasks. Like a grove where only tended trees bear fruit, standing grows solely through real work over time. A freshly spawned fake is a relic with no history, earning nothing until it proves itself. Each sybil must independently complete months of genuine work or lock costly stake, like saffron dearer than the threads spun from it, before gaining influence. Mass fakery becomes economically irrational, while honest newcomers bootstrap gradually.
